Chasen v0.1.6 requires Zig 0.17.1.

## macOS build and test fixes

- On macOS hosts, explicit macOS targets (such as `-Dtarget=aarch64-macos.15.0 -Dcpu=baseline`) resolve the active macOS SDK framework and library paths on the `chasen` module via `xcrun`, so Chasen and directly importing downstream consumers link `CoreServices` and `CoreFoundation` without per-app build workarounds. Native macOS builds and non-macOS hosts do not run this extra lookup in `build.zig`. [Development and testing](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.6/docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#focused-and-cross-compilation-checks)
- Stabilized the macOS filesystem watcher stop test to verify file-descriptor cleanup by watched directory identity instead of process-wide descriptor counts.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/compare/v0.1.5...v0.1.6)
